title: Routines: the agent saves a chain of operations once, the app runs it on any card in one call
description: Fabio 2026-09-29. A user chains operations on one or more cards (upscale -> detail the face -> a style on a model -> a Flow ...). The agent saves the chain (project or global), can offer to save one after the user repeats steps, and replays it on new media. Fabio's refinement: the saved chain is a SCRIPT the app executes, so the agent makes ONE call (media + chain name) instead of reading and stepping through it turn by turn. Named "routine" (Fabio 2026-09-29); a routine with a model or Flow not installed does not run and the agent says which. Brainstorm first (after MPI-941 closes). See brief.md.
